blocks.heading: What is GHK-Cu100?
blocks.body: Copper tripeptide profile for skin, collagen, antioxidant, and tissue-regeneration research. Coze describes GHK-Cu as glycyl-L-histidyl-L-lysine copper, a naturally occurring tripeptide in plasma, urine, and saliva, reviewed for collagen and glycosaminoglycan synthesis, wound healing, skin regeneration, antioxidant activity, and anti-inflammatory signaling. GHK-Cu 100mg is mapped to LPPeptide SKU CU100. Current storefront values use our product data: 100mg x 10 vials /box, $50.00 USD per box. LPPeptide reference specs: 50mg x 10 vials / 100mg x 10 vials.
